claim: a systematic audit found four more unconverted tick quantities, including two per-tick probabilities that would have fired eight times too often
found: 1/24000 per second at 4TPS, 1/3000 at 20TPS, eight times too often
1/2000 per second at 4TPS, 1/250 at 20TPS, eight times too often
direction_matters: periods divide by GAME_TICKS_PER_TICK, probabilities multiply by TICKS_PER_SECOND. Choosing wrong shifts the rate by 5x for periods and 8x for probabilities.
fix: periods via server_ticks(STARVE_GT=80) and server_ticks(FLUID_TICK_GT=30); probabilities via RAIN_CHANCE_DENOMINATOR = 6000 * TICKS_PER_SECOND / 4 and MOB_SPAWN_CHANCE_DENOMINATOR = 400 * TICKS_PER_SECOND / 4
implementation_error: the test first asserted the wrong invariant for probabilities, comparing ticks per second times the old denominator against the new denominator. The correct relation is TICKS_PER_SECOND * old == 4 * new.
audit_method: search for tick counters via -= 1 and += 1 on struct fields, then check their initialisers and thresholds; separately search % N == and classify each as period or probability
excluded: plate_powered st % 2 is a block-state bit test; rand_u64() % N is not tick based; % 5, % 6, % 23, % 601, % 197, % 89 are state encodings and worldgen
fourth_instance: fourth occurrence of the same class, after lava t % 2, air 60, and the projectile TTLs
remaining: the combat invulnerabilityTime model is still unimplemented; hurt_at 500ms is real time and cadence independent; shield cooldown 5s matches vanilla
